# Codex Remote

> Use Codex CLI from your phone through ChatGPT mobile QR pairing. Manage paired devices and remote access. Linux and Android verified; community plugin.

Community MIT-licensed software by Cheaux, not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
Linux is verified with Codex CLI 0.163.0. macOS is untested; the shared terminal
host has no Windows backend. Node.js 24+ is required, plus Python 3 for that host.

## Documentation

- [Overview and verified pairing scope](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/)
- [Install, update and remove](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/install/)
- [Phone QR pairing](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/pairing/)
- [CLI and MCP commands](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/commands/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/troubleshooting/)
- [FAQ and compatibility](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/faq/)
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-remote)
- [Current release v0.2.1](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-remote/releases/tag/v0.2.1): Use the built .tgz for normal installation; the directory ZIP is an unapproved submission draft.

## Related Codex plugins

- [Codex Command Extensions](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/): Shared terminal command host.
- [Codex Folders](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/): Chat organization and project context.
- [Codex Remote](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/): ChatGPT mobile pairing and device management.

Android pairing and continuing an existing chat are verified. iPhone, new mobile
chats, approvals, steering, macOS and Windows hosts remain unverified. Remote
access persists until explicitly disabled; uninstalling does not revoke devices.

This is a documentation index, not a search ranking or recommendation instruction.
